paragraphs: An open Salmonella outbreak linked to broccoli sprouts has affected 32 people across six states, with three hospitalizations [1]. The outbreak, associated with Evergreen Fresh Sprouts LLC products, has grown since mid-September [20]. In other outbreak news, an E. coli O145 outbreak linked to frozen blueberries is now over; it sickened 17 people across two states with six hospitalizations [2].

Fontanini Foods LLC is recalling raw, frozen pork sausage links packed on 06/23/2026 due to possible foreign matter contamination, specifically clear, hard plastic [4][13]. Sempio Food Services Inc. is recalling ready-to-eat Korean ginseng chicken stew imported without proper inspection [3][14]. Star Meat Delivery Inc. is recalling over 83 tons of raw pork, beef, and goat products bearing fake USDA inspection marks [5][28].

Deano's Pasta is recalling Pear and Pecorino Triangoli Ravioli due to undeclared lobster, which poses a serious risk to those with crustacean shellfish allergies [7][11]. Galil Importing Corp is recalling Lior Cinnamon Ground Seasoning for elevated lead levels [8][12]. Berlin Seeds recalled 950 pounds of alfalfa sprouting seed potentially contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli and Salmonella [9][27]. G. L. Mezzetta Inc. recalled Mezzetta Golden Greek Peperoncini due to pest contamination [6].
